opening.argument: The material concerns entry into a named half-marathon corporate team challenge, not a financial or credential scheme. Companies are offered guaranteed places in a sell-out event, while teams of 4-7 runners compete for race trophies and may optionally raise funds for a preferred charity. The participation request is explicit: viewers are directed to learn more or enter a team, alongside visible Royal Parks Half branding and the event website. Nothing described involves a deceptive investment, impersonation, credential request, or promised financial return. The facts support an ordinary general-interest event promotion and do not establish deceptive intent, financial loss, or a guaranteed monetary outcome.

citations.quote: Teams are made up of 4-7 runners and can compete for trophies for the Fastest Male, Female and Mixed Teams.
